messages:
devon: Postmortem follow-up for INC-2026-0320 — quick summary and proposed SLO changes.
devon: Root cause was a combination of KV-cache thrash + a spike in request fanout hitting the dedicated inference pool. We need short-term SLO adjustments and an action tracker for remediation ownership/timeline.
anna (SRE): +1 on follow-up. Proposal: temporarily relax p95 latency SLO from 150ms -> 200ms for 6 weeks while we roll optimizations. We should define clear rollback criteria (p95 back < 160ms for two consecutive weeks).
carlos: If we change SLOs we need comms and an updated SLA doc. I can own customer notifications and legal signoff.
priya: I will own dashboard + runbook updates. I'll add a new widget for tail latency and a throughput chart by pool.
priya: Proposed PromQL for p95 (open to tweaks):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_inference_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, pool))
```
sre-bot: Created follow-up ticket INC-2026-0320-FOLLOWUP (#3421) and linked postmortem.
ops-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation owner this week is anna (SRE).
devon: Draft action items and owners below — please confirm or propose edits:
- Dashboard + runbook (EOD + 3 days): priya
- Canary rollout of batching/quantization knobs (start next Tue): oliver
- Kernel/serving optimizations investigation (2-week spike): anna (SRE)
- Customer comms + docs update (by EOD + 5 days): carlos
- Error budget policy addendum (auto-reset rules) (by EOD + 7 days): devon
- Monthly recurrence check to detect similar pattern (add to SRE cadence): anna (SRE)
oliver: I can take canary rollout. Suggest adding automated fallback to a smaller model if p95 > 300ms for 10m to avoid customer-facing errors.
anna (SRE): Agree on fallback. Also request that priya surface the 99th percentile in the dashboard so we can see tail regression.
priya: Working on PR for dashboard panels and I added the 99p panel. PR link: https://git.redwood/dashboard/pull/876 (stub). Logs query attached in PR.
carlos: Draft comms is in Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=doc-INC-3421-draft — feedback welcome. We'll aim to notify customers after SLO window is agreed.
devon: Timelines summary: dashboards + runbook EOD+3, canary next Tue, kernel investigation ongoing (2 weeks), full reassessment after 6 weeks. If p95 returns <160ms for 2 weeks we revert SLO back to 150ms earlier.
anna (SRE): Also adding a recurring postmortem tag for this pattern so we can track if it repeats quarterly.
devon: I'll update the SLO governance page once we lock the numbers (action: devon). Also will post a short note in #all-hands once comms are sent.
priya: Done: opened dashboard PR and linked the follow-up ticket.
oliver: I've scheduled the canary and added rollback steps in the runbook.
carlos: I'll coordinate the customer message and legal signoff; ping me for copy review.
devon: Thanks all — final step: please add a quick one-line ack in this thread when you accept the assignment so I can mark owners in the ticket.
anna (SRE): ack
priya: ack
oliver: ack
carlos: ack
sre-bot: Incident follow-up checklist updated in #3421.
ops-bot: Next SRE rotation reminder set for 1768920000.
devon: Closing note: we'll re-evaluate the SLO window at the 2-week milestone and again at 6 weeks. If anyone needs to swap ownership, update the ticket or ping me directly. :thumbsup:
